title: anacamptis papilionacea var. grandiflora
intro: Anacamptis papilionacea var. grandiflora, commonly known as the large butterfly orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the orchid family. The large butterfly orchid is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its antispasmodic and expectorant properties, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. By utilizing the large butterfly orchid in a controlled and medicinal manner, individuals may be able to harness its therapeutic potential and experience relief from certain health conditions.
